description: This file defines a Smarty plugin modifier called 'in_array' which checks if a value is present within an array. It is used within the Smarty templating system to incorporate array membership checks dynamically in templates.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_in_array
methods.description: Checks if the specified value ($needle) is present in the given array ($haystack). Returns false if haystack is null or empty, otherwise returns true if the value exists in the array.
